 Anthony Bourdain’s legacy in Russia : State of the World from NPR Eight years after the death of Anthony Bourdain, people around the world still mourn the beloved chef, author and TV star. At a movie theater in Moscow, hundreds of Russian fans gathered recently for the premiere of ‘Tony,’ the new Hollywood film based on Bourdain’s early life. Among them was a man Bourdain loved to call “international man of mystery,” someone who became essential to Bourdain’s success in Russia and beyond. Our Moscow correspondent introduces us to him.  
Please note: this story contains mentions of suicide.  If you or someone you know is in crisis, in the U.S. call or text 988 to reach the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline.
